Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Ingram
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 119 as introduced would increase the expenditures of the Employees' Retirement System (ERS) Expense Fund by approximately $2,000 annually for travel expenses for the two new ERS board member positions established by this bill.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
